content: लेखन {%a.%} (-नी|{%f.%}) [लिख्-ल्यु ल्युट् वा] .²1 Writing, painting, scratching <ab>&c.</ab> .²2 Exciting, stimulating. .{@-नः@} A kind of reed of which pens are made. .{@-नम्@} .²1 Writing, transcribing. .²2 Scratching, scraping. .²3 Grazing, touching. .²4 Attenuating, making thin or emaciated. .²5 Cutting or making incisions (in surgery). .²6 Scripture. .²7 An instrument for scraping. .²8 A kind of birch-tree. .²9 A palm-leaf (for writing upon). .{@-नी@} .²1 A pen, writing-reed, reed-pen; सुरतरुवरशाखा लेखनी पत्रमुर्वी <ls>Śivamahimna 32</ls>. .²2 A spoon.
